requirements.evidence: Contract fully covered: atomic pairing with the preset row locked and no-oracle rejections (app/Actions/PairTotem.php:27,:54); effective scope = JWT claim intersected with the current join (app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:49-54); queues/priorities/ticket payloads exactly as specified (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemQueueController.php:41, app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemTicketController.php:33-49); routes use throttle:10,1 and throttle:30,1 (routes/api.php:11,:22); CORS localhost-only with no credentials (config/cors.php:24-36); docs flipped from proposal to implemented.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through new actions and the existing IssueTicket (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemTicketController.php:40); generated-style migrations with reversible down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_033346_create_totem_presets_table.php:30); deliberate #[Fillable] (app/Models/Totem.php:15); CHANGELOG, docs/api/totem.md, architecture.md and database-schema.md updated. Deviations: composer.json:13 adds firebase/php-jwt with no composer.lock update in the diff, and docs/business-rules.md was not touched.

security.evidence: JWT decoding is pinned to HS256 via Key (app/Totem/TotemToken.php:43,:62) with a 32-character secret check (:72); every request re-checks totem, preset, entity and updates last_seen_at (app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:25-56); input validated with an anchored regex and is_int (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:24, app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemTicketController.php:33); queue resolution is entity-scoped and scope-checked (app/Context/TotemContext.php:42-54); CORS has an explicit localhost pattern and supports_credentials = false (config/cors.php:28,:36); pairing codes are never logged (app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemAuthController.php:46).

tests.evidence: Pest coverage for auth failures including expired, foreign-signed, inactive/deleted totem and preset and entity mismatch (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemApiTest.php:75-109), live scope add/remove (:263-296), priorities, tickets, 403/404/422 and throttle (:362-418); pairing window, format errors, no-oracle 401s, single-use, old-code rejection, throttle and audit-without-code (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemPairingTest.php:14-160); CORS allow/deny/preflight (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemCorsTest.php:19-88); model/factory/JWT unit cases (tests/Feature/Totem/TotemModelsTest.php:13-61).

simplicity.evidence: Reuses IssueTicket and keeps a single small enum and context (app/Enums/TotemPriority.php:11, app/Context/TotemContext.php:32-54), but the preset queue-id extraction is duplicated in app/Totem/TotemToken.php:37 and app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:49.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with useful docblocks (app/Actions/PairTotem.php:54, app/Context/TotemContext.php:32-54); names mirror the contract (entity, preset, queueIds); no dead code, debug output or leftover scaffolding.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the totem task: actions, middleware, controllers, enum, migrations, factories, routes, CORS, phpunit env pins, docs and CHANGELOG; the database-schema edits are limited to the totem tables and the removal of the obsolete api_token_hash.

issues.explanation: firebase/php-jwt is added to require but the diff never updates composer.lock; if the lock is tracked (normal for a Laravel app), composer install/CI will not have the package and the JWT code cannot load until the lock is regenerated and committed.

The conventions list docs/business-rules.md for domain invariants, but the new pairing TTL/single-use and effective-queue-scope rules are documented only in docs/api/totem.md and docs/database-schema.md.

The note claims a consumed code is kept so it "cannot be reissued to another preset", but the next totem:pairing-code overwrites login_code, freeing the old value for another preset, so the stated invariant only holds until regeneration.

The queues()->pluck('queues.id') int-casting sequence is duplicated in app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:49; a TotemPreset::queueIds() helper would keep the queue-scope definition single-sourced.

newLoginCode() does a read-then-write uniqueness check with no lock or retry, so two concurrent generators can pick the same code and the loser fails on the unique index with an unhandled QueryException; low likelihood for an operator-run command, but it is an unhandled failure mode.

The test mutates $_SERVER['TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN'] and calls refreshApplication() mid-test, which is brittle and can leak environment state into later tests; set the value through config()/test helpers instead.
Carbon::utc() mutates the instance that is also the model's issued_at attribute; use ->copy()->utc() or toIso8601ZuluString() to avoid a surprising side effect while formatting the response.

review.summary: Implements the totem BFF end to end: totem/preset/join migrations, models and factories, the pairing command with an atomic PairTotem action, HS256 JWTs, the totem.auth middleware with claim-intersected queue scope, the three endpoints backed by IssueTicket and a backend-owned TotemPriority enum, per-route throttles, CORS and updated docs. Every contract detail and edge case is covered with strong Pest tests; the main things to address are the missing composer.lock for the new dependency, a couple of doc inaccuracies, and duplicated queue-scope logic.
